selection_rule: Highest validation top-1 ranking accuracy, then lowest validation MAE.

linear_regression: Ordinary least squares on the 4 features.
decision_tree: Single CART tree, depth 12, min 5 samples per leaf.
random_forest: SRS spec: 100 trees, depth 8, min 5 samples per leaf.
extra_trees: 100 randomised trees, depth 12, min 5 samples per leaf.
hist_gradient_boosting: Histogram GBM, up to 500 rounds, early stopping.
mlp: 64-32 ReLU network, Adam, early stopping, standardised features.
